text:
dave_csm: Quick flag  — Solstice Labs renewal in 12 days. Signals: weekly active seats down 50%, onboarding checklist stuck at 40%, and churn risk score bumped to red. Need a compact 7-day save play we can run without heavy engineering work.

elaine_ops: Ops reality: their ingest runs on a dedicated jobclass. We can flip them to 'ingest-lite' which pauses realtime transforms but keeps CSV exports. Quick impact: 24h to enable, no infra changes.

morgan_success: Proposed 7-day play: Day 0: 30m health call + give 14-day usage credit; Day 2: enable ingest-lite + run replay to surface missing reports; Day 4: 1:1 enablement with product tips; Day 6: decision check (renew / downgrade / archive).

jules_support: FYI saw a pattern of failed report renders for Solstice: `ERROR render/task-44 timeout 120s`. Filed SUP-2401. Might explain low adoption.

dave_csm: Love the cadence. Need two non-negotiables in the downgrade-safe path: 1) preserve exports for 60 days, 2) maintain read-only API token so they can pull historical reports. Elaine, confirm we can do that.

elaine_ops: Confirmed: exports retained 60d, read-only API token can be created. I've provisioned `solstice_readonly_60d` and will enable ingest-lite within 24h once we sign-off.

morgan_success: Messaging snippet for the call: "We noticed activity dip and want to help. We'd like to run a short enablement and temporarily enable a lite ingestion to preserve your key reports. If adoption recovers, we'll roll everything back. Otherwise we'll migrate you to a lighter plan but keep exports accessible for 60 days."

jules_support: SUP-2401 root cause: a regression in the render-worker retry logic. Short-term mitigation: increase timeout to 180s for Solstice and monitor. Pushed patch to canary.

archive-bot: Task created: 'Solstice 30m health call' assigned to morgan_success due 2026-03-29.

dave_csm: Action owners: morgan -> schedule + run call, elaine -> enable ingest-lite + readonly token, jules -> monitor SUP-2401 and confirm patch status. I'll prep the credit approval with finance. Keep thread updates short.

morgan_success: Scheduling now. I'll include a 3-question post-call survey and permission request for recording.

elaine_ops: Ingest-lite enabled (ETA 18h) and readonly token prepared. Dropping the export path: `s3://redwood-exports/solstice/2026-03/`.

jules_support: Patch rolled to canary. Will watch error rate for 12h and report back.

dave_csm: Good. If we see no improvement after the call, we follow the downgrade pack and offer archival to cold storage. Updates here please. :handshake:
